purpose: Inspect the directory and suggest a useful descriptive comparison. The experimental unit and measurement units are not established.
mechanism: descriptive raw distribution plus unsmoothed empirical cumulative fraction
expected_benefit: The box/points preview shows every supplied source row and a descriptive median/IQR; the ECDF shows the fraction of source rows at or below each value with unsmoothed jumps.
observed_tradeoff: Measurement unit and experimental unit remain unknown; batch is retained as a source field and is not declared as a unit or pairing key. Both are descriptive alternatives, with no automatic aesthetic winner or inferential P.
record_timing: Purpose, roles, actual burden and concrete geometry were planned in create-intent.json, initial spec.json and agent working notes before first rendering; this durable summary was consolidated after bounded image review.
